audit.whatIsWrong: Rows 1-6 gave Trundle every stage except an even 2+ items, while the whys say you take over at 3 and hold it through two items ('the game-long edge is Volibear's').
audit.why: packet.levelChart is Trundle, Skill, Volibear, Volibear, Volibear, Volibear, Volibear — matching the prose and the 53.11% win rate. Only Level 1 is his, on Chomp's bite and AD sap.
audit.corrected: Rows 1-6 set to packet, paired across both layers, ratings raised.

audit.why: Spikes are right: your level 3 Frenzied Maul sustain, the Stormbringer dive at 6, bruiser items, and grouping late against a duelist.

audit.whatIsWrong: Subjugate was described as 'steals your stats' with no cooldown; Pillar of Ice appeared only as 'pillar-kited'; Frozen Domain as a place not to duel; King's Tribute never appeared at all.
audit.why: Subjugate is 120/100/80s and steals health, armour AND magic resist, doubling over 4 seconds — it makes you squishier at the same time it makes him tankier, which is why the fight after he spends it is free. Pillar of Ice is 21/19.5/18/16.5/15s at 1000 range and becomes impassable terrain, so it hard-blocks Stormbringer's leap. Frozen Domain (18s at rank 1) increases his healing from ALL sources, which is the actual reason for the anti-heal buy, and King's Tribute heals him off every nearby unit death — he sustains off your own minions dying.
audit.corrected: All four written in with real numbers and the terrain-vs-leap interaction stated.
